prose_changes.old: By 2010 this was how most of the world's Catholics had worshipped for more than forty years. That makes it one of the largest continuous formation traditions on the map. By then the restored catechumenate had become the ordinary route by which adults entered the Catholic Church. The vernacular liturgy and lay ministries had been absorbed so fully that they read as normal rather than as a change. In 2010 the argument over the older rite was unresolved. This map carries it on its own dated documents rather than describing it as a mood.
prose_changes.new: By 2010 most of the world's Catholics had worshipped this way for more than forty years. By then the restored catechumenate was the normal way for adults to join the Catholic Church. Mass in people's own language and lay ministries had become so much a part of life that they no longer felt new. In 2010 the argument over the older rite was still open. The church's own dated rulings record it, from Ecclesia Dei in 1988 to Summorum Pontificum in 2007.
